summary: Enthusiastic HR professional with 3+ years of experience in university recruitment, talent acquisition, and employee development. Proven ability to resolve issues, improve processes, and build strong campus partnerships. Seeking a full‑time role in Human Resources or Talent Acquisition in the San Francisco Bay Area.

experience.title: CurrentUniversity Programs Lead
responsibilities: Developed university recruitment strategy for LexisNexis North America to build talent pipelines and increase brand awareness.
Launched the company’s first program for new graduate FTE hires and expanded the intern program from <10 to 50+ interns.
Communicated with internal stakeholders to determine people strategy and campus hiring targets per function/location.
Built relationships with key university partners to position the company as an employer of choice.
Created targeted outreach and engagement strategies for schools focusing on D&I and business priorities.
Attended on‑campus and virtual career fairs, events, and hack‑a‑thons.
Managed budget for all university recruitment related expenses and measured ROI each cycle.

experience.title: HR Associate
responsibilities: Conducted full‑lifecycle university recruitment (sourcing, screening, selecting, hiring, onboarding).
Learned multiple HRIS systems and recruiting platforms including Workday, Taleo, and Handshake.
Led the company internship program and facilitated training for interns across different functions and locations.
Served as student liaison for the company hackathon, growing participation from 20 to 100+ attendees.
Proactively communicated with business partners, hiring managers, and external candidates to resolve issues and ensure a positive recruitment experience.
Gained proficiency in compensation and benefits, training and development, employee relations, and regulatory compliance.

experience.title: HR Intern
responsibilities: Co‑developed university recruitment strategy for Raleigh‑based hires by researching universities, local events, and career fairs.
Executed social media strategy to support branding and served as campus liaison for the annual company hackathon.
Tracked a funnel of 500+ intern applicants to assist in candidate selection.
Partnered with VP Talent Development to create and present a leadership sustainment webinar for Zenger Folkman 360 feedback participants.
Used MS Excel to create enhanced data structures during the product manager career framework deployment.
Implemented, tested, and conducted surveys for a newly introduced scavenger hunt app as part of the employee onboarding 2.0 development plan.

experience.title: Orientation Leader
responsibilities: Served as first‑hand liaison for 250+ students to facilitate smooth transition to NC State University.
Facilitated parent panels, conducted student small groups, and led guided tours for incoming first years.
Trained in diversity and inclusion workshops to foster an inclusive and welcoming community.
Enhanced written and oral communication skills through daily public speaking and email communication.
